description: A trash for an SvGrid Base, in Svelte 5. Deleted records, fields and tables are kept with who deleted them and when, and Restore puts each back: a record in its place with its links, a field with its values, a table as a tab. The trash is plain data bound with bind:trash, so the app stores it, and items older than trashDays are dropped.

faq.question: Where is the trash kept?
faq.answer: In the trash prop, an array of plain items. Bind it, or listen to onTrashChange, and store it next to the tables. Nothing is sent anywhere by the base itself.

faq.question: How long do items stay?
faq.answer: 30 days by default. Set trashDays to change it, or 0 to keep items until the trash is emptied. Older items are dropped when the base opens.

faq.question: Can every item be restored?
faq.answer: A record whose table was deleted waits until the table is restored, and the dialog says so. A record or field that is already back cannot be restored twice; the Restore button is off and its title says why.
